2026.description_en: Current mixed-traffic buses, 50¢ flat fare, fragmented suburban bikeways, $28 CBD parking.
2026.description_zh: 現行混流公車、50¢ 單一票價、外圍斷裂自行車道、CBD 停車費 $28。

2032.description_en: Cross River Rail (CRR) underground express, Brisbane Metro 1&2 + Chermside extension, Kangaroo Point Green Bridge, 3-min headways.
2032.description_zh: Cross River Rail 地底捷運、Brisbane Metro 雙向延伸至 Chermside、袋鼠角綠色天橋、3分鐘尖峰班距。

2040.description_en: 100% Zero-Emission Electric Bus fleet (ZEB), 100% continuous PCNP shaded bikeways (50% tree canopy), SEQ Faster Rail, sub-3m turn-up-and-go.
2040.description_zh: 100% 零排放電動公車、PCNP 全線立體林蔭自行車道 (50% 遮蔭率)、SEQ 提速鐵路、隨到隨走班表。

2050_Regulated.name_zh: 2050：淨零多模態 MaaS（動態道路定價）
2050_Regulated.description_en: Dynamic Road User Charging ($20 congestion fee), 50¢ on-demand autonomous feeder shuttles, seamless zero-wait transfers.
2050_Regulated.description_zh: 尖峰動態道路擁擠收費 ($20/趟)、50¢ 隨選自駕微型接駁車、全網零延遲轉乘。

2050_Unregulated.name_zh: 2050：無管制自駕車反噬危機（無道路定價）
2050_Unregulated.description_en: Autonomous cars allow sleeping & entertainment in transit without road pricing, inducing severe traffic rebound and cannibalizing public transit.
2050_Unregulated.description_zh: 自駕車可車內補眠放鬆且無擁擠收費，引發報復性自駕反彈，嚴重侵蝕大眾運輸佔比。
